scenes.title: Ship QA that can defend itself.
scenes.body: Ticket + MRs → gated suite → multi-mode CUA → BVA script → Learning Engine → PageSpeed AI → cost you can see.

scenes.title: Normal tools leave holes.
scenes.body: Chatbots invent steps. TMS stays hand-written. CR never becomes a test. One CUA mode is not enough. Cost stays opaque.

cards.p: Pretty cases. Weak grounding. No AC proof.
No Test Set batch, no adversarial, no BVA script.
Numbers without an AI good/bad call — or a price.

scenes.title: Closed loop — not a chatbot.
scenes.body: Author, review, prove, run CUA + BVA, learn from corrections, judge performance, show AI cost.

steps.p: Bug gate · PageSpeed AI · op cost

journey.title: Story + sources loaded.
journey.voice: DEMO-1414 with AC, worklogs, Figma links, and three live MRs — Primary, Region, Theme.

ticket.summary: FedEx Pickup location at checkout — US storefront only
ac: Guest + signed-in: search FedEx Pickup by ZIP on shipping step
Selected location shows name, address, distance, hours
Place Order disabled until a pickup location is chosen
Billing address required — never overwritten by pickup
Change limited to US — UK / AU keep prior shipping UI

journey.title: Suite drafting with Full coverage.
journey.voice: Ledger before the diff. LEARNED RULES ride the prompts when validated. Coverage proven, not scored.

progress.t: LEARNED RULES — 3 validated (step setup, no named account)

casesPreview.s: Guest ZIP search selects FedEx location
UK checkout has no Pickup from this change (F2)
Live deploy soft-nav keeps checkout usable

journey.title: Review ran while cases drafted.
journey.voice: Three MRs. Shared diffs once on Primary. ERR-STATUS catches XError extends AppError — not only a bare throw.

bugs.t: Pickup search 5xx mapped to empty list + 200 (base-derived class)
Pickup mounts without US store guard
Same change on region fork (copied from Primary)

journey.note: Locale parity OK · no conflicts · store-scope never auto-cleared on ports · AI cost on this review

journey.title: Independent score: 94 / 100
journey.voice: Not an average suite. Every parameter ≥ 92. Weakest still caps overall — and it passes hard.

journey.title: Load checks + AI step check.
journey.voice: Oracle, overlap, merge — and Describe-a-test gets an AI check for extra / missing / vague steps before any browser opens.

advisories.why: No page shows transfer size without inspect_elements
Suite-level claim — no single page oracle
Same setup · read-only · 1 run instead of 2
AI check steps: two actions in one step · one invented ZIP

journey.summary: 41 → 38 runnable · 1 merge · step advice ~$0.03 · never silent deletes

journey.title: Batch priced by planned steps.
journey.voice: Estimate uses fitted $/step — not a flat per-run average that under-priced 7–11 step BVA-style cases.
journey.batch: 1 FAIL · evidence on FAIL · estimate within ~4% of actual on 60 long runs

journey.title: Risk plan with fake reply + wait_for_text.
journey.voice: Exploratory can poll for copy and fake a storefront reply for races — still human-gated on defect.

plan.note: Empty list toast — same F1 class

journey.title: Product page check — $0, no model.
journey.voice: M1–M8 from the live PDP: one non-default per option group, reload, bag, cart, Edit Cart — Playwright only.
journey.note: vs agent run $0.70–1.90 a case — script caught the letter bug with zero AI spend

journey.title: Proof pack for every FAIL.
journey.voice: Video, steps, DOM inspect, transfer sizes — enough for a human to file or dismiss.

items.v: 14 actions · assert failed on error copy

journey.title: Defect card — awaiting review.
journey.voice: Never auto-Jira. Human picks File bug, test problem, or skip. Ties to F1 from MR review.

bug.summary: Pickup search 5xx rendered as “No locations nearby” — Place Order stays blocked
bug.covers: F1 · ERR-STATUS · Test Set #4 · Exploratory fake 503
repro: Force pickup search API 503 (or Exploratory fake reply)
Observe empty list copy · no retry

journey.title: Corrections become rules.
journey.voice: Tester edits and CUA reviews become candidate learnings. Validate once — they ride matching prompts. Repeats are counted.
rules: Checkout/cart cases name guest vs signed-in and bag contents (no-setup)
Never invent a named account — describe what it holds
Sizing claims need a state or px value (vague-expected)
journey.note: Build into code ranks detectors the linter should own next

journey.title: Lab metrics · AI verdict: BAD
journey.voice: Checkout mobile after Pickup assets. CLS is fine — LCP is not. AI says do not ship until fixed.

ai.headline: Mobile checkout not ship-ready for this change
bullets: LCP 3.4s — FedEx map / location tiles compete with LCP element
Performance 61 < 80 bar used for checkout templates
CLS 0.03 is GOOD — layout not the blocker
Recommend: lazy-load map after location open · re-run PSI · target LCP ≤ 2.5s

journey.compare: Desktop Performance 88 · AI GOOD — mobile-only gate

journey.title: One total per job — not a mystery bill.
journey.voice: Generate, CR, KB ask, enrich, Learning analyse… each operation shows calls + USD. Cached replies count as $0.
journey.note: Same OperationCost line the app shows on Ask Angara, CR, Enrich, PageSpeed…

journey.title: Autopilot complete.
